note: Qwark / unmaze brand tokens: brand #001484, Roboto Serif Qwark type scale (title-medium, label-large, label-medium), Material Design 3 aliases, button/icon color families. Pulled via mcp__Figma__get_variable_defs and get_design_context from the Button, Icon Button, Checkbox, and Radio nodes. State-layer overlay colors (color.overlay.*) are literal rgba values read directly off each Button type/state variant in Figma (Primary/Tonal use a blue/cyan overlay at 12/20/30% hover/focus/pressed; Outline/Text use a dark-neutral overlay at 8/12/20%) -- these are exact per-type ramps, not derived from a shared opacity token. Icon Button reuses the same overlay ramp since Figma has no distinct Icon Button state-layer samples in this file. Dark-mode overlay values (semantic.dark.json color.overlay.*) are NOT fetched from Figma -- this file has no dark-mode Button variants -- and are a reasonable adaptation (outline/standard overlay swapped to white since the Figma light-mode value #343A3F is illegible on a dark surface).
